ruled_out_vectors.vector: Zero-price bypass via computeRatioX96 overflow in validateHandlerOrder
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: computeRatioX96 returns 0 on overflow (SqrtPriceCalculator.sol:51-53). In validateHandlerOrder (AMMStandardHook.sol:218), if minSqrtPriceX96 is set, 0 < min triggers revert. If only max is set, sqrtPriceX96=0 passes but this is the CLOB path where openOrder already validates MIN_SQRT_RATIO/MAX_SQRT_RATIO (CLOBHelper.sol:90). Overflow requires amount1 > 2^64 tokens which is infeasible for standard ERC20s. Direct swap path has explicit zero check at _validatePricingBounds (L847). No profitable extraction path.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Direct handler call bypass — calling executeSwap directly to skip beforeSwap/afterSwap hooks
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: ammHandleTransfer checks msg.sender == AMM at CLOBTransferHandler.sol:230-232. executeSwap is internal. All external CLOB entry points (openOrder, closeOrder, depositToken, withdrawToken) are guarded by nonReentrant. Cannot call handler directly to bypass pricing enforcement.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Settings sync gap — stale memSettings in CreatorHookSettingsRegistry after setTokenSettings
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: tokenSettings loaded from storage at swap start, used throughout. setTokenSettings is admin-only (onlyOwner) and nonReentrant. Settings are read fresh each swap via storage read. No attacker-accessible path to change settings mid-swap.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Transient storage leak — DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT not cleared on all paths
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: On Cancun EVM, tstore auto-clears at end of transaction. Even in storage fallback mode (Tstorish), before/after hooks are always paired within nonReentrant swap. beforeSwap writes slot, afterSwap reads it. No path where stale value persists to next swap.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: SwapMath rounding exploitation — manipulate rounding direction to extract value from pool
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: All rounding directions favor the pool. amountIn rounds UP (SwapMath.sol:53 mulDivRoundingUp), amountOut rounds DOWN (SwapMath.sol:77 mulDiv), feeAmount rounds UP. Standard Uniswap V3 convention — attacker always pays more, gets less.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: FeeHelper division-before-multiplication truncation
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: All fee calculations use FullMath.mulDiv or mulDivRoundingUp (single atomic operation with 512-bit intermediate). No div-before-mul pattern. Protocol fee extracted from exchange fee (FeeHelper.sol:187), remainder stays with LP.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: uint256 to uint128 truncation in fee accumulators
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Standard Uniswap V3 pattern. tokensOwed0/1 are uint128. Would require >3.4e38 tokens of accumulated fees to overflow. Fee growth uses intentional overflow wrapping (Q128 fixed-point). Not realistic.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Assembly calldataload without masking — dirty high bits treated as valid
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: calldataload at AMMModule.sol:2057 is properly masked with shr(0xA0) check ensuring upper 96 bits are zero for address. Other assembly blocks validate returndatasize before reading.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Short returndata exploitation — read past returndata into garbage memory
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: returndatasize checks present before mload. Hook return at AMMModule.sol:1784 checks lt(returndatasize(), 0x20). Transfer handler return at AMMModule.sol:2310-2318 validates both offset and length bounds.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: 100% fee asymmetry — input accepts 100%, output rejects
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Input: With 100% fee, all input goes to fee, 0 output. Self-inflicted by pool creator. Output: exchangeFeeBPS >= MAX_BPS reverts because denominator (MAX_BPS - feeBPS) would be 0. By design.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: swapExtraData != 32 bytes causes silent default price limit
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: If swapExtraData.length != 32, defaults to MIN_SQRT_RATIO+1 (zeroForOne) or MAX_SQRT_RATIO-1 (!zeroForOne). This is the WIDEST possible range — attacker hurts themselves by not setting a limit.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Operator precedence bug in FixedHelper withdrawLiquidity bitwise OR vs equality
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Expression `redeposited0 | redeposited1 == 0` at FixedHelper.sol:69. Solidity bitwise OR `|` has LOWER precedence than `==`. So this evaluates as `redeposited0 | (redeposited1 == 0)` NOT `(redeposited0 | redeposited1) == 0`. HOWEVER: examining the context, when redeposited0=0 and redeposited1>0, the expression becomes `0 | false = 0`, which is falsy — revert does NOT trigger. When redeposited0>0 and redeposited1=0, expression becomes `nonzero | true = nonzero`, truthy — revert does NOT trigger. Only when both are 0: `0 | true = 1`, truthy — revert DOES trigger. The behavior matches intent: revert only when BOTH are zero.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Tick crossing at exact boundary — liquidity not properly added/removed (KyberSwap-style)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: DynamicHelper.computeSwap follows Uniswap V3 pattern. Tick crossing at L411-427: only crosses if sqrtPriceCurrentX96 == nextTickSqrtPriceX96. Fee growth inversion at _crossTick correct. Tick assignment prevents double-crossing.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Fixed height split rounding to zero — free tokens via calculateShareDeltaForLiquidityConsumption
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: If newShare <= currentShare after rounding, returns (0, shareDelta) — no consumption occurs. _splitAmountsAndFeesByHeight validates totalAmountInFilled/totalAmountOutFilled != 0 at L1656.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Division-before-multiply in _decreaseHeight/_increaseHeight fee distribution
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Fee distribution at L1820 uses diminishing-pool technique: feeDistributed = mulDiv(feeAmount, returnedAtHeight, amount), then both decremented. Last iteration inherits residual.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Flashloan fee precision — manipulate fee rounding to repay less than borrowed
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Uses mulDivRoundingUp for fee calculation. Balance-check pattern verifies post-loan balance >= pre-loan + fee. NonReentrant protected. Fee rounds UP (favors protocol).

ruled_out_vectors.vector: SqrtPriceMath._getNextSqrtPriceFromAmount0RoundingUp fallback path precision loss
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Fallback only triggers on product overflow (amount * sqrtPX96 overflows uint256). Uses divRoundingUp ensuring conservative price movement. Less precise but ROUNDS UP — attacker gets worse, not better, price.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: calculateShareDeltaForLiquidityReturn underflow at boundaryLiquidity - totalConsumedLiquidity - 1
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: boundaryLiquidity = mulDivRoundingUp(newShare+1, den, num) and totalConsumedLiquidity < (newShare+1)*den/num. Therefore boundaryLiquidity > totalConsumedLiquidity, making subtraction safe. Solidity 0.8.24 would revert on underflow anyway.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Free memory pointer corruption via assembly
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: No assembly blocks in target repos modify the free memory pointer. All are marked memory-safe and use scratch space (0x00-0x3F).
ruled_out_vectors.test_file: code-analysis: grep for mstore(0x40) — none found in src/ directories

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Extra ABI-encoded bytes appended to call — parser reads garbage as valid params
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: All calldata decoding uses standard Solidity abi.decode which reads from correct ABI offsets. swapExtraData length-checked at DynamicPoolType.sol:433. No raw calldataload of variable-length user input in core math paths.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Dust-loop compounding extraction — 100+ tiny swaps to accumulate rounding surplus
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Dynamic pool: all rounding favors pool. Fixed pool: dust per swap bounded by potentialDustForOneInput. Gas cost per swap (~100k gas) vastly exceeds dust value (~1 wei). Not economically viable.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Forged hook caller — call hook directly with fake pool identity
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: All AMMStandardHook entry points check _requireCallerIsAMM(). msg.sender must equal the AMM address. Cannot credit tokens without legitimate swap.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Transient-slot theft — write to transient slot in path A, trigger path B that reads stale slot
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Same as KV-4. Cancun tstore auto-clears per-transaction. Before/after hooks paired in nonReentrant context.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Permit mutation — replay signature with mutated unsigned feeOnTop fields
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: feeOnTop not signed but paid by msg.sender (caller), not the signer. Attacker modifying feeOnTop only drains themselves. By design — limitAmount caps total exposure.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Storage-slot collision — diamond proxy vs hook contract storage overlap
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Hook contracts are separate deployed contracts (not delegatecall targets from diamond). Pool types use msg.sender-keyed mappings. Diamond storage at 0x9A1D is isolated. No collision possible.

theft_theses.thesis: Dust-loop extraction via repeated tiny swaps in fixed pool to accumulate rounding surplus
Tick crossing boundary exploit (KyberSwap-style) to desync liquidity tracking in dynamic pool
Precision loss compounding in fixed pool height system via withdraw/redeposit cycle
theft_theses.asset: Precision-truncated tokens from height precision rounding

theft_theses.thesis: computeRatioX96 overflow returning zero to bypass pricing bounds in CLOB orders
theft_theses.victim: Token creators with pricing bounds configured

theft_theses.thesis: Fee asymmetry at 100% boundary enabling zero-cost swap extraction

lens_coverage.L1_trace: Traced fee values through SwapMath -> DynamicHelper.computeSwap -> feeGrowthGlobal. Traced fixed pool fees through _splitAmountsAndFeesByHeight -> _decreaseHeight/_increaseHeight -> feeGrowthGlobal. All denominations consistent (same token throughout).
lens_coverage.L2_diff: Diffed addLiquidity vs removeLiquidity in DynamicPoolType (same modifyPosition with signed liquidityChange). Diffed swapByInput vs swapByOutput in SwapMath (different rounding directions but both favor protocol). No asymmetries found.
lens_coverage.L3_amp: Checked all multiplications: fee*amount uses FullMath (512-bit intermediate), no overflow. price*quantity in fixed pools uses packedRatio (pre-simplified by GCD). Max amplification = 1x (no denomination mismatch found).
